checks.layout: Entry path fixed inside legacy-publish-safety; detached safety HEAD must equal lowercase40 GITHUB_SHA. Runtime CWD must remain inside workspace and outside safety root.
checks.byte_pins: Feed, adapter, and e6 guard source bytes must all pass canonical Git-blob SHA before preparation imports or pinned-source execution. Cached adapter/guard keyed by absolute path plus digest; pins rechecked each call.
checks.legacy_namespace: Actual race_ai and saved_view_feed loaded from old CWD, module __file__ paths verified; only old CWD may be inserted in sys.path. No safety-root or newer parser package insertion.
checks.installer: Runs exact b438 adapter against identical old feed and exact e6 guard before target import. Old feed reader, parser, decryption, repository and transport functions are not called by entry.
checks.cli: Only scripts.racer_intraday_refresh allowed. Target origin fixed to old CWD script. Passes arguments without shell parsing, runpy supplies normal module execution argv[0], restores caller sys.argv, preserves normal target output and numeric SystemExit codes.
checks.privacy: Preparation stdout/stderr discarded. Exceptions and nonnumeric exits yield fixed HOLD JSON/2; inline preparation raises fixed ValueError outside private exception handler, without visible chained private exception.
checks.io_scope: Entry reads only public source files and checkout metadata, GITHUB_WORKSPACE, GITHUB_SHA. No direct source provider, network, subprocess, key enumeration/access, saved view read, bootstrap open, decryption, write/publication call.
checks.tests: Ten independent invocation tests cover the fixed constants, real old CWD import, argv/install ordering, identical readers, idempotence and recheck, refusals before import/exec, numeric exits, privacy, and guarded I/O traps.

scope: Entry review only. Workflow integration reviewed separately by parent team. No runtime, tests, refs, workflow, dispatch or publication mutation performed.
